question: What is the arithmetic mean of all positive two-digit multiples of 7?
solution:
The two-digit multiples run from 7 · 2 = 14 to 7 · 14 = 98; the adjacent multiples, 7 and 105, are not two-digit numbers. The terms are equally spaced, so the first and last terms average to the same value as the second and next-to-last, and so on. The middle term is also that value. Thus the mean is (14 + 98)/2 = 56.
Final answer: 56
